generatedSecrets.name: CODE_SERVER_PASSWORD
generatedSecrets.description: Password for the authenticated workspace browser sign-in. Read this once during deployment, store it safely, then seal the Railway variable.

generatedSecrets.name: CLOUDDEV_WORKSPACE_AUTH_SECRET
generatedSecrets.description: Independent signing secret for workspace cookies and the private Caddy authentication check. Seal this Railway variable.

generatedSecrets.name: FORGEJO_POSTGRES_PASSWORD
generatedSecrets.description: Password for Forgejo's dedicated PostgreSQL role. Seal this Railway variable.

generatedSecrets.name: FORGEJO_ADMIN_PASSWORD
generatedSecrets.description: Bootstrap password for the initial Forgejo administrator. Read it for first sign-in, then change the account password and remove or seal the bootstrap variable.

generatedSecrets.name: INITIAL_PASSWORD
generatedSecrets.description: Bootstrap password for OmniRoute's native dashboard login. Read it for first sign-in, change the password, then remove this bootstrap variable.

generatedSecrets.name: JWT_SECRET
generatedSecrets.description: Independent OmniRoute JWT signing secret. Seal this Railway variable.

generatedSecrets.name: API_KEY_SECRET
generatedSecrets.description: Independent secret used by OmniRoute to protect its API keys. Seal this Railway variable.

generatedSecrets.name: STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY
generatedSecrets.description: Independent OmniRoute data-encryption key. Seal this Railway variable and preserve it in protected backups.

generatedSecrets.name: MACHINE_ID_SALT
generatedSecrets.description: Independent OmniRoute machine identity salt. Seal this Railway variable.

generatedSecrets.name: OMNIROUTE_WS_BRIDGE_SECRET
generatedSecrets.description: Independent secret for the private OmniRoute WebSocket bridge. Seal this Railway variable.

operatorInputs.name: SSH_AUTHORIZED_KEYS
operatorInputs.description: Enter one or more operator Ed25519 public keys, one per line. Never enter a private key.

postDeploySetup.name: Provider credentials
postDeploySetup.description: The operator connects their own provider account after deployment. No provider key is preloaded or passed to the IDE.

postDeploySetup.name: Scoped inference credential
postDeploySetup.description: Create a restricted inference key after provider setup. ai-setup stores it in the persistent workspace configuration used by the coding agents.
